global.title: OpenAI safety employee resigns, claiming the company’s ‘culture is broken’
global.summary: By his own admission, David Robinson is “something of a cliché”: an employee at a leading AI company who issues a dire warning while resigning from their job.
global.titleKo: 오픈AI 안전 담당 직원 사임 "회사 문화가 망가졌다"
global.summaryKo: 오픈AI 안전 담당 직원 데이비드 로빈슨이 회사 문화가 망가졌다고 주장하며 경고와 함께 사임했다.
global.summaryEn: OpenAI safety employee David Robinson resigned, claiming the company's culture is broken and issuing a warning as he left.

global.title: Muse Creates Detailed Profiles of All Your Friends and Family
global.summary: Millions have downloaded Meta’s AI agent Muse. But getting it to do your bidding comes with privacy costs.
global.titleKo: 메타 AI 에이전트 Muse, 친구·가족의 상세 프로필까지 만든다
global.summaryKo: 수백만 명이 메타의 AI 에이전트 Muse를 내려받았지만, 이를 활용하려면 친구·가족의 상세 프로필 생성 등 사생활 비용이 따른다.
global.summaryEn: Millions have downloaded Meta's AI agent Muse, but getting it to do your bidding comes with privacy costs, including detailed profiles of users' friends and family.

global.title: Chatham scales its capital markets expertise with OpenAI
global.summary: Chatham Financial uses Codex and GPT-5.6 to build technology and redesign workflows, cutting trade validation from 30 minutes to under 4.
global.titleKo: Chatham Financial, Codex·GPT-5.6으로 거래 검증 30분→4분 미만 단축
global.summaryKo: Chatham Financial이 Codex와 GPT-5.6으로 기술을 구축하고 업무 흐름을 재설계해 거래 검증 시간을 30분에서 4분 미만으로 줄였다.
global.summaryEn: Chatham Financial uses Codex and GPT-5.6 to build technology and redesign workflows, cutting trade validation from 30 minutes to under 4.

global.title: The Den frees up 10-15 hours a week to grow with ChatGPT Work
global.summary: As it opens a new location, the social club prepares grant applications in 2 hours instead of 3 days and liquor-license materials in 3 hours instead of 4 days.
global.titleKo: 소셜 클럽 The Den, ChatGPT Work로 주당 10~15시간 절약
global.summaryKo: 소셜 클럽 The Den이 ChatGPT Work로 주당 10~15시간을 절약하며 보조금 신청서는 3일→2시간, 주류 면허 서류는 4일→3시간으로 단축했다.
global.summaryEn: Social club The Den frees up 10-15 hours a week with ChatGPT Work, preparing grant applications in 2 hours instead of 3 days and liquor-license materials in 3 hours instead of 4 days.
